facts.fact: Nairametrics reports Nigeria's National Broadband Plan 2020-2025 expired in December 2025, four months before the article, though an NCC commissioner said the plan 'has not ended'.
NCC Executive Commissioner Abraham Oshadami said the regulator is reviewing the old plan's performance and is coming up with a new plan to succeed it.
The article sets NCC data of 51.97% broadband penetration (December 2025) against the plan's 70% target, and 52.95% of mobile subscriptions on 4G against its 70%-by-2023 milestone.
